tokens.typography: Manrope for headlines/key metrics; Inter for UI/body according to brand-kit/brand-guidelines.md
tokens.spacing: Use the canonical application spacing scale/components; avoid ad-hoc raw spacing where an existing semantic owner exists

style.iconography: Simple functional iconography consistent with the application; icons reinforce meaning and never replace critical text without accessible labels
style.motion: Restrained, purposeful feedback/continuity/progress motion; no decorative motion that competes with financial decisions
style.imagery: Functional product/data visuals first; brand imagery may support orientation but the UI remains understandable without decoration
style.voice_microcopy: Clear, calm, direct and non-judgmental; explain financial state without promising returns or presenting financial advice

spring.default: Motion spring with restrained damping and no distracting overshoot
spring.bounce: Use only for meaningful completion/attention and never for frequent financial controls

motion_tokens.reduced_motion_strategy: Respect prefers-reduced-motion/platform settings by removing non-essential transforms and preserving immediate state/feedback clarity
